# Finish strings

Every finishing input found so far, with when it was found and how. All are for character 4 (motorcart) and
finish by a one-frame quantum-entanglement (QE) launch ([SEARCH.md](SEARCH.md)). They were found by Maximum
using the search tools in this repository. A TAS is eight bits per frame (left, right, up, down, space, shift,
ctrl, z); see [CLI.md](CLI.md). "Frame-perfect" (FP) inputs are key presses or releases that must land on one exact
frame.

Replay any of them:

```powershell
target/i686-pc-windows-msvc/release/hw.exe sim --level 3214 --char 4 --tas reference/tas/finishes/gbeqe-finish-f227-fp13.tas
```

## Summary

Fewer frame-perfect inputs is easier to execute by hand; a lower frame is faster.

| Level | Finish frame | Time | FP inputs | Found (UTC) | How | File |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gut Bus Extreme (3214) | 217 | 7.23 s | 27 | 2026-09-23 17:04 UTC | `hw-search qe` from `qe-seeds/gbeqe.tas` | `reference/tas/finishes/gbeqe-finish-f217.tas` |
| Gut Bus Extreme (3214) | 227 | 7.57 s | 15 | 2026-09-28 03:41 UTC | frame-perfect reduction of the 217 finish (`hw-search` `qe --fp`, tail bases) | `reference/tas/finishes/gbeqe-finish-f227-fp15.tas` |
| Gut Bus Extreme (3214) | 227 | 7.57 s | 14 | 2026-09-30 02:55 UTC | search run `gbe-aligned-repair-14` | `reference/tas/finishes/gbeqe-finish-f227-fp14.tas` |
| Gut Bus Extreme (3214) | 227 | 7.57 s | 13 | 2026-09-30 03:40 UTC | search run `gbe-bundle-repair-19` | `reference/tas/finishes/gbeqe-finish-f227-fp13.tas` |
| A large Satan eats u (2433) | 125 | 4.17 s | 33 | 2026-09-23 17:04 UTC | `hw-search qe` from `qe-seeds/satanqe.tas` | `reference/tas/finishes/satanqe-finish-f125.tas` |
| A large Satan eats u (2433) | 125 | 4.17 s | 23 | 2026-09-28 03:41 UTC | frame-perfect reduction of the 125 finish | `reference/tas/finishes/satanqe-finish-f125-fp23.tas` |

**About the dates.** The first-solve times are the commit times of the files; the search itself ran earlier that day.
The 14 and 13 times are the `verified_utc` stamps in their verification records, and the 15 and 23 times are commit
times. Where a string was derived from another, the source is in `derived_from` in `reference/tas/launches.json`.
The 15 and 23 reductions were made by searches whose own outputs are not in this repository, so their exact search
runs are not recorded here.

**Flash status.** All six are valid finishes in the real game. The 14 and 13 runs carry verification records
(`finishes/*.verification.json`) showing a match against the original Flash trace; the trace for the 13 run is not in
the shipped trace subset, and `launches.json` does not list the 13 and 14 finishes.
